objective: Materialize one bounded inspection surface for the default recompute dry-run execution path after the live-writeback contract is complete, confirming that non-canonical outputs exist in the copied dry-run workspace while the canonical recompute surfaces remain pending and unchanged.

phase_plan.requirement: Confirm the live-writeback contract report classifies the repo as dry-run ready and live locked before executing the bundle
Require one materialized dry-run recompute execution bundle report under the non-canonical dry-run workspace
Require the dry-run workspace baseline report to exist for the same bounded execution family
All three dry-run recompute surfaces must show computed outputs and completed latest triggers
The canonical recompute surfaces must remain without computed outputs and keep their latest triggers pending
The dry-run execution bundle must explicitly report that no live writeback was performed
The post-plan recompute-monitoring path may remain pending because canonical surfaces were not mutated
Authority mirrors may register dry-run execution readiness and inspection outcome, but must not claim canonical recompute completion
The next action after inspection must remain defining canonical live baseline semantics or approval conditions before any live writeback

non_claim_boundary: Repository-local recompute dry-run execution inspection only; no scientific adequacy claim and no implied canonical recompute completion.
